title: Keep AI under human control
introduction: We love using ChatGPT. We also believe powerful AI needs independent scrutiny, meaningful safeguards, and public accountability.
summary: We support the Statement on Superintelligence: prohibit its development until scientists broadly agree it can be built safely and kept under control, and the public supports proceeding.
invitation: You can read the statement and decide whether to add your name.
label: Read & sign the statement
